source.method: Read current authorized production bundle composition and existing raft-ui@0.6.0 recipes. Structural port, not a screenshot redraw or full latest TSX copy.

rootCause: Updating shared primitives did not replace old page compositions. Retained wrappers still overrode semantic typography, section geometry, chips and secondary actions. Prior source tests did not cover these compositions.

changes.before: Handwritten old headings, elegant override, font-display and padding.
changes.after: Native SidebarRoot/Header/HeaderTitle and PanelSectionHeader/HeaderContent/Title. Explicit h1 render retains accessible navigation; single local workspace title retained.

changes.before: 12px uppercase tracking-widest heading,24px local flat buttons; counts only on private group.
changes.after: Native SidebarSectionHeader/Disclosure/Count/Control,14px chevron,16px plus/sort. Existing drag/context menus/revisioned mutations retained.

changes.before: Old eyebrow/11px text buttons/outline chips/manual focus styling.
changes.after: Current SearchResultsSectionHeading, shared TextLink, soft chips,14px icons,22px remove target and original hover/touch edit semantics.

changes.before: Old bold text and2px description border.
changes.after: Native headline/mono-meta/callout and Separator; authoritative membership lookup remains.
Official warning Banner with icon/action slots; unchanged retry/cursor ownership.

automated.build: npm run build:web:workbench passed; existing chunk-size and dynamic-import warnings remain

failuresResolved: New source regression checks failed before implementation.
Navigation caught lost heading semantics after primitive replacement; fixed with render h1.
Older navigation test still expected the intentionally removed desktop Settings header; now checks header absence plus list/detail presence.
fixtureLimit: message-references uses fake CLI; fake Codex MCP discovery rejects unsupported command. UI hover/navigation passed; this does not constitute runtime or paid-provider acceptance.

deployment.transient: First page probe overlapped the graceful restart and saw connection refused. After successor verification, fresh desktop/mobile probe passed.
